reviews.text: [h1][b]长大了真当太空人，而且与“果冻”进行塔防肉鸽交战[/b][/h1] 果冻广告预言的果然没错，长大了真能当太空人，不过是[b]牛马形态[/b]，我们将扮演宇宙矿工，矿船坠毁后，与矮人同事们失联在一个满是[b]史莱姆[/b]生态的外星。 我们将利用手边的矿机在不同矿山进行挖掘，一方面是[b]不忘马䁖本命完成各种KPI[/b]（完成游戏目标进行通关，有助于解锁新地图，一些成就的完成有助于局外解锁），另一方面寻回失联的同事，[b]解锁更多矿机[/b]。 [i]游戏本地化现阶段还比较粗糙，比如说这里“品阶”（rank）是对的，但是在其他处这个被翻译为了“排名”[/i] 游戏并不是传统的路径依赖（塔防的[b]兵来将挡[/b]，肉鸽的[b]简单增量[/b]），而是在深度策略与爽玩乐趣之间找到了适度点，通过抽卡来同步动线设计，构建[b]矿场与战壕，每一关通关一般20分钟左右，后期的布阵难度并未成为负累。[/b] [h2][b]爽游逻辑与策略玩法：在卡牌中完成矿场的布局[/b][/h2] 入局后分为准备和战斗两个阶段，大部分的卡牌（[b]通道类、设施类、局内天赋类等[/b]）属于准备阶段进行安置的；少部分卡牌则是[b]战斗时才能进激发[/b]的，类似[b]局内技能[/b]对史莱姆进行击退。 矿场以扩张为始，玩家须用[b]通道卡进行动线设计[/b]，方块是每一个通道不同的“门”，通道覆盖之处可以架设武器、挖掘机（前提是该部分有矿产）以及向上探索，但是门即机遇的同时也是[b]危机，因为每一波次的史莱姆大军都将从门内出现[/b]。 若没特殊的局内天赋，开门越多或许会让史莱姆更容易靠近我们的基地，因此，[b]扩张前必须节制[/b]，但是一味压缩阵地会让我们达不到主线目标。 [i]关底波次需要玩家手动触发，最好是发育良好之后再招惹BOSS[/i] 发育的起点是电力，最好在基地附近布置密集的[b]交叉火力网[/b]，并在其中布置[b]发电机，差不多有30格电力，火力与挖掘带来的回合收益就会比较可观了。[/b] 既然矿场，玩家需在资源点放置钻探机，它们会和我们的基地一起，每抵御一次敌人，就会带来一次[b]波次收入（两种矿物，都可以最终变为货币），整体体验不算太难的原因是除了丰富的局内外成长之外，游戏的波次收入递增会比怪物每波难度的递增要快。[/b] 这些矿场所需要的物力，都被藏在[b]以百计的卡牌组合之中[/b]，获取卡牌的方式通常是在商店，[b]购买数卡合一的卡包会比购买单卡更有性价比。卡包有概率开出专长卡，[/b]即局内天赋，每个设施武器拢共三级，既可以通过叠放相同等级的同名卡进行升级，也可以使用升级卡进行强化。但就发电机这张卡而言，有空间就多放一级发电机即可（因为升级只是节约空间，而不是成倍提升电力上线）。 [h2][b]莱骗偷：塔防的即时博弈同样精彩[/b][/h2] 如果说准备阶段是对史莱姆波次动线的初次规划，通过设立门扉与诱饵尽可能让我们的设施都活下来（只有活下来才有波次收益，而且制作组做了难度降低，即便[b]这一波次设施被摧毁，通过该波次后设施会自动复原）[/b]。四十多种史莱姆触发条件各有不同，而且属性相生克，玩家同样[b]需要挂元素反应[/b]。 战局内，玩家同样可以蓄爆道具卡，到BOSS出没时候疯狂打僵直，只有中后期面对满屏史莱姆时，对玩家的局部微操和动态用牌有一定要求，其余时刻，玩家只需要在每一波“[b]战备-验证[/b]”的循环中提高开采效率，然后在商店进行丰囤，最终择定时机进行通关。 游戏内是[b]高筑墙、广积粮、缓称王[/b]，而真正真正体现肉鸽重玩价值之处，还应是局外成长以及主控角色的差分感，本作通过[b]三大公会矿机的不同调性、局外配件的安置以及公会升级后带来的终局增益，[/b]让这款[b]既需要动态开点，又需要定点防守[/b]的游戏每一把都有策略感的正反馈，但又不会过于陷入纯粹增量的无脑。 [quote]欢迎关注 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45531068/]黑白测评[/url] [hr]黑夜显真 白昼辨伪

Yeah, this is great. A proper gem - feels kind of like an updated old-school game, it's full of charm and I love that it's kind of left to you to work out how everything kinda slots together. Very satisfying.
Something about digging out the mine is very satisfying. Tons of different turrets and enemies, looking forwards to rescuing all my crew.
It was a decent game I got hooked on it. You buy cards, dig, and build defenses against slugs. It's fun, but I haven't managed to escape the moon yet.

If you're into stealth games—skip this one! This game isn't for you. Here, you prepare for the next wave of slugs, and with each new wave, it gets harder and harder to fend them off. In between preparing to fend off the attacks, you try to squeeze in a little bit of mining, hahaha This game is all about contrast and madness!!!!

It’s boring at first, but after about 20 minutes, it gets fun and everything makes sense! A giant slug explodes in a really fun way The whole game loop: + Upgrade your setups so they get destroyed + Repeat It’s some kind of repairman simulator, but it’s no slouch. - It has atmosphere; I’d call it a true indie game, but the price tag is too high. I really appreciate the effort of my repair crew, but they move slower than any old lady. Sometimes it gets too hard. It’s a H4RD game, but it’s a gem for speedrunners. My rating: 8/10

This game was a surprise, its a challenging tower defence game! I don't remember the last time I actually lost my core. Having to balance upgrade rounds, digging rounds and when I am geared up enough to take on the boss was a fun experience, Also the amount of content in this game, from what I can tell, is far more than I would have expected. Worth a play!
I'm enjoying it so far, and I keep closing it after I win a run then re-opening it 2 minutes later to play another run

I like the game's concept, I like the modern approach, I like the combo upgrade system, I even like the economic aspects of purchasing items (for example, a set of cards costs less than buying them individually) but I don’t like spending so much time building structures. You just have to constantly build, build, build again! AGAIN! Get rid of this maniacal tower-building, and then it’ll be a 10/10. I’m serious.

Played the demo, and Into the Restless Ruins, and I am enjoying the direction this game has taken. Deck builders are my jam, and the snowballing gameplay mixed with the aesthetic of the Deep Rock Galactic games is a winner for me. Lots of content. A few hours in and I'm only scratching the surface of the metagame upgrades and stages/levels possible. A satisfying gameplay loop in short bursts. I can see myself returning to this game again and again for more.
Great fun TD game mixed with exploration as you dig out your mine. Really enjoyable gameplay loop as you absolutely obliterate some slimes! Looking forward to putting more hours in to this!

Really enjoying getting into this one - I got a lot from the demo, and currently just digging (pun intended) the vibes, and the little tweaks and improvements. Perfect pace for a solid second screen experience for me so far!
If you are a fan of deckbuilders/roguelites, this is an easy recommendation. Very polished and the sci-fi dwarf setting gives it a lot of charm. You’ll find yourself saying “just one more run” a lot!

I really like this one. The roguelike slightly random nature of the buildings you can procure makes this enjoyable for more than a few runs, coupled with different buildings and slightly different strategies for each of the three dwarf factions. The Difficulty ramps up slowly, but I have found a real challenge in one of the later dig sites(ice cave), that one was fun to puzzle out how to best start. One thing I am on the fence about is the selection of gadgets, most seem useless in the sense that I'd rather spend my ressources on some permanent tower upgrades than a one time ability. I found 75% of what was on offer there not that useful, especially the repair seems borderline useless. Tower upgrade gadgets could use a bit more variety, rather than only dmg up(which also would increase the chance of gettign them with a wider pool), giving that would make trying to reach higher waves less of a tower spam. But the only thing I really disliked so far was the inability to do some of the early dig site side objectives until far later in the meta progression - eg digging obstacles. solid 8.5/10 for me

This is a Tower Defense Game. All of the craftdwarfship is of the highest quality. It is made from rocks, stone, slime, and sheer brilliance. Putting that bit aside seriously, this game gets what it is to be a Dwarf, leaving no one behind, mining for ore, technology, and the humor. The humor is just. So good. Card based tower defensing has never been my favorite but it truly works well here, having to not have the perfect defensive setup, hacking together energy costs with mining, defense, and utilities. Some brilliant mechanics at work here. The fact that removing already placed towers being a separate card that only has a chance to show up is a bit frustrating, but legitimately that aside? Its brilliantly put together. The meta progression is a simple as just playing the game more. No need to do some goofy insane stunts, just play the game and play it well and you unlock things. I genuinely hope more people find this game. Its a lovely little thing that is an absolute joy to play.

Greatly enjoying the game so far and it feels like there's a decent balance of difficulty. At a certain point you do tend to have your defences 'run away' from the ability of the slimeoids to be a threat, but at the same time you start having to deal with the pain of power restrictions and frankly: you've basically won the map at that point and are only chasing an objective, whether set by yourself or the game. Not something strictly speaking 'needed' to complete the level. Sure, there's times when you can rapidly end up trapping yourself in the early game of a level but frankly that's just one of the risks of both maze builders and deckbuilder roguelikes so it's not a point against the game. It's merely the standard warning of 'Some Level of Thought Required To Play'. Just like I'm certain that the higher levels will have more challenge to deal with as shown by the way the different zones have different map elements you need to take into account (the acidic hot springs can certainly be a hassle for example). I've also enjoyed the small bits of humour scattered throughout the game. Yes FORGE, I do think we should follow Senior Management's demands exactly as stated, have to follow the boss' instructions after all!

[h1]史莱姆矿难简评[/h1] [quote]关注小红瓶，回血在当下点击关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45932802/] 小红瓶游戏评鉴组[/url][/quote] [h2] 个人游玩与体验 [/h2] 这是一款融合了卡牌肉鸽加塔防元素的游戏，游戏的画面风格是采用的是像素风格，整体的画面表现还行，像素建模这些有点以前复古街机的味道。 游戏讲的是我们的采矿飞船出了事故，坠落在了一颗全是史莱姆横行的星球上面，我们需要营救找到失踪的船员和对战史莱姆，同时还要去采矿运回满载矿石的货物，游戏的内容玩法还是很丰富的，有不同阵营的钻探台和不同的采矿点可以选择，会带来不同的加成和牌组，游戏的塔防玩法路线还是完全由自己来构造规范的，不是常见的塔防游戏的那种固定好的路线，游戏还融入了卡牌元素用来挖矿和建筑，还有各种功能卡牌，在游戏里面还可以购买各种卡包，整体玩起来策略和趣味性都还是非常在线的，游戏把卡牌，肉鸽和塔防这些元素融合的不错，不过游戏上手还是有一定的门槛的，需要一些时间才能够熟悉游玩。 游戏玩下来整体质量还是不错的，国区的价格定价也很合理，还有捆绑包优惠，推荐给喜欢这种像素画风和融合了卡牌肉鸽塔防元素玩法的玩家去游玩体验。 欢迎加入:[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/xiaohongping] 小红瓶游戏评鉴组[/url]

The demo hooked me (which doesent happen too often to any great degree) and the main game has let me continue on my merry way. As TD titles go, this is very interesting and different - you will have to think a lot as the game gradually educates you in its nuances. Not easy and I have lost a few games - interesting upgrades. Can't wait to give it another go!! (without getting divorced).
好玩，但是马上全部通关3星乐，可能就没什么可玩性了，希望再多出一些可玩性内容，新的关卡，新的挖掘装备，新的难度等等~
